champion.tips: MAOKAI TIPS AND TRICKS Use your Saplings E to scout for vision in nearby lane bushes. They will help protect you when your trinket is on cooldown. Maokai’s Ultimate R is great in team fights. Once you engage with your Ultimate R , fall back and peel your carries. You’re not at your strongest in the early game. When playing against a strong early game champion, avoid fighting them until you’ve got some items under your belt.
champion.builds: THE BEST MAOKAI BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Maokai Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Manaflow Band and Transcendence in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Sunfire Aegis as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Winter's Approach. For your last 3 items, you should build Unending Despair, Thornmail and finish with Spirit Visage. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 52.7% winrate over 497 matches played. Optional Your second option for Maokai Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Hollow Radiance, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Winter's Approach as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Unending Despair, Thornmail and Spirit Visage. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 52.7% win rate over 258 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Transcendence in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Health Scaling, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Unending Despair as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Winter's Approach as a third item. You want to finish the build with Spirit Visage, Thornmail and Liandry's Torment. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 58.3% win rate across 168 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Maokai Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Grasp of the Undying, Font of Life, Second Wind and Revitalize as your primary rune tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Health Scaling and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Winter's Approach as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Unending Despair as third item. The last 3 options are Spirit Visage, Thornmail and Knight's Vow. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 52.6% win rate over 114 matches played. Situational Maokai Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Maokai build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Maokai runes page.
